summary.text: Margo Juarez is a member of the Nebraska Unicameral Legislature representing District 5, and was elected in 2024, according to the Legislature's biography.
The Legislature lists Margo Juarez's occupation as a customer service professional.

paragraphs.text: Margo Juarez was born on April 30, 1958, in Omaha.
Margo Juarez graduated from Omaha South High School in 1976.
Margo Juarez is a member of the South Omaha Neighborhood Alliance, the Assistance League of Omaha and the Metro Women's Club.
